_doc: Capital Markets chart brand config — Briggs Brand Standards v3 / Northmarq 2024 guide. Single source of truth for CM chart typography, palette, series-ramp order, and color proportions. Loaded by api/_shared/cm-native-chart-injector.js (CM_BRAND). Per-vertical overrides live under `verticals`. This is DATA, not code — a future brand-guide update is a JSON change, not a code change.

_source._provenance_note: The three authoritative source files live in Scott's OneDrive (_WORKFLOW folder) and were NOT reachable from the build sandbox. Values below are taken from Scott's A1-v2 token spec (stated as derived from Briggs v3) and cross-checked against public/reports/cm_brand_tokens.json (reverse-engineered from the gov master workbook theme). _typeface_note: Open Sans is the Excel-safe default that renders on every machine. Flip `typeface` to Futura PT ONLY once it is confirmed installed on every machine that opens these workbooks, else Excel silently falls back to the theme font.
_series_note: Report CHART series order (marketing-review decision, 8/2026 — supersedes the prior tertiary-order seeding): NM Blue (003DA5), Sky (62B5E5), Blue 85 (265AB2), Steel (9EA9B7), Slate (6A748C), THEN the tertiary ramp (Aquamarine, Peridot, Amethyst, Tourmaline, Topaz, Morganite) for the 6th+ series only. Report charts stay in the blue/neutral family; tertiary hues (peridot/amethyst/etc.) remain sanctioned for INFOGRAPHIC / tile use per the 2024 guide but are NOT the primary series colors on report charts. This decision is recorded here so it is not re-litigated from the guide text (which lists tertiaries at slot 4). Primary blues dominate; use slot N for series N.
_text_note: Chart axis/category labels are Rich Black 191919 regular (2024 guide category/label rule) — supersedes charcoal for CHART labels; charcoal (3D4A54) stays for worksheet body cells per Briggs §2. Callout numbers: one color per chart, NM Blue default (use Sky 62B5E5 where the series itself is NM Blue, for contrast). Superscript $/+ and the '$5B+' convention apply to the report's KPI tiles, NOT Excel chart data labels (n/a for dLbls).
_banned_note: Retired off-brand accents/grays. Slate #6A748C is intentionally NOT banned (it is the on-brand axis/legend neutral).
